newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December S&P 500 futures finish higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December S&P 500 futures finish higher.

text.p: Sept 19 - U.S. December S&P 500 futures finished higher in moderate trading, led by bullish momentum after shaking off early weakness. Traders called market rangebound, with a bias to the upside. Resistance lurks at 695.00 contract high. The Sep S&P 500 expired firm at the close and will settle against Friday's opening price.
